snippet.title: CRUSH DEPTH Game Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3938760/CRUSH_DEPTH/

CRUSH DEPTH is first-person sci-fi horror game set at the bottom of the ocean. A salvage operation that would set you up for life goes sideways when you realize you're not alone down there. You'll solve puzzles and run from danger as you uncover the mysterious fate of Eclipse Station.

Coming Fall 2025.
